translation: David d yegdud ⟨את⟩ i illan ɣer tama-s, zzin-d iḥder-agi deg iman-nnsen: ula d nutni ur zzin ara, ttin i ṣebḥen d tegrawla, David d wid akk illan ɣer tama-nnsen lan yiwet n teqsiḍt: imezwarḍen ger David d wid i d-yezzin ɣer tama-s lan imeḍfaṛen ger David d imezwarḍen i d-yezzin ɣer tama-s: Dvid d-yeqsiḍen ɣer tama-s
